caption: The drawing depicts a toy-like object consisting primarily of red and beige colors. The main body is a tall, rectangular red structure standing vertically with its lower front edge shaded in beige, and a string or cord extends downward from its base. Attached to the top is a figure with a rounded beige face drawn with simple red lines showing a smiling expression, red cheeks, and closed eyes. The body of the figure features red crosshatch lines, a blue horizontal stripe, and red vertical lines to suggest clothing details. The figure's arms and legs appear as simple, flat, red mechanical components connected with visible round rivets or fasteners, allowing for movement. One arm and one leg are extended outward, both attached near the top of the main vertical body. The background is plain and unadorned, colored in an off-white tone.
title: Humpty Dumpty Jumping Jack
